command:
set -eu
for p in /etc/pki/tls/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt; do
  if [ -e "$p" ]; then
    printf 'present %s\n' "$p"
    stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U:%G size=%s' "$p"
  else
    printf 'absent %s\n' "$p"
  fi
done

set -eu
for p in /etc/pki/tls/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt; do
  if [ -e "$p" ]; then
    printf 'present %s\n' "$p"
    stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U:%G size=%s' "$p"
  else
    printf 'absent %s\n' "$p"
  fi
done

set -eu
umask 077
install -d -m 0700 /etc/pki/tls/private
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:4096 -sha256 -days 3650 -nodes \
  -subj '/CN=OS Comparison Root CA' \
  -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE,pathlen:0' \
  -addext 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign' \
  -addext 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash' \
  -keyout /etc/pki/tls/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key \
  -out /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt \
  2>/dev/null
chmod 0600 /etc/pki/tls/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
chmod 0644 /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
update-ca-trust extract
printf 'created_and_extracted\n'

set -eu
umask 077
install -d -m 0700 /etc/pki/tls/private
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:4096 -sha256 -days 3650 -nodes \
  -subj '/CN=OS Comparison Root CA' \
  -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE,pathlen:0' \
  -addext 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign' \
  -addext 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash' \
  -keyout /etc/pki/tls/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key \
  -out /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt \
  2>/dev/null
chmod 0600 /etc/pki/tls/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
chmod 0644 /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
update-ca-trust extract
printf 'created_and_extracted\n'

set -eu
ca_cert=/etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
ca_key=/etc/pki/tls/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
stat -c 'key_mode=%a key_owner=%U:%G' "$ca_key"
stat -c 'cert_mode=%a cert_owner=%U:%G' "$ca_cert"
openssl x509 -in "$ca_cert" -noout -subject -issuer -serial -dates -fingerprint -sha256
openssl x509 -in "$ca_cert" -noout -text | awk '/X509v3 Basic Constraints/{print; getline; print} /X509v3 Key Usage/{print; getline; print}'
key_pub=$(openssl pkey -in "$ca_key" -pubout -outform DER 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
cert_pub=$(openssl x509 -in "$ca_cert" -pubkey -noout | openssl pkey -pubin -outform DER 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
test "$key_pub" = "$cert_pub"
printf 'private_key_matches_certificate=yes\n'
trust list --filter=ca-anchors | awk 'BEGIN { RS="" } /label: OS Comparison Root CA/ { print; found=1 } END { if (!found) exit 1 }'
probe_dir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$probe_dir"' 0 1 2 3 15
openssl req -new -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -sha256 -subj '/CN=system-trust-probe.invalid' -keyout "$probe_dir/leaf.key" -out "$probe_dir/leaf.csr" 2>/dev/null
printf 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:FALSE\nkeyUsage=critical,digitalSignature,keyEncipherment\n' > "$probe_dir/leaf.ext"
openssl x509 -req -in "$probe_dir/leaf.csr" -CA "$ca_cert" -CAkey "$ca_key" -set_serial 1001 -days 1 -sha256 -extfile "$probe_dir/leaf.ext" -out "$probe_dir/leaf.crt" 2>/dev/null
printf 'system_bundle_leaf_verification='; openssl verify -CAfile /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt "$probe_dir/leaf.crt"
